blocks.text: CALASIAO, Pangasinan – The Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources will tap the sun’s power to help fishery stakeholders cope with the super El Niño by providing solar-powered aeration systems for fish cages and ponds. “This is still in the finalization stage, but we believe this will be a big help during El Nino,” said Isidro Velayo, BFAR assistant director for technical services, during the Third National Bangus Congress last October 14-16 in Clark, Pampanga. Velayo said the BFAR was still “fixing the mechanism” for the project and that the solar-powered paddle wheels are still in the pilot stage and being […]...
